description.zh: 带权图里路径代价是权重之和；迪杰斯特拉每次确认暂定距离最小的点，像洪水从起点漫开；负权会让它出错（贝尔曼–福特对照）；网格地图上泥地代价决定穿过还是绕开；A* 用启发值少确认一些格。小图与网格的教学实现，O(V²)。
description.en: In a weighted graph a path’s cost is the sum of weights; Dijkstra settles the smallest tentative distance each time, like a flood from the start; negative weights make it fail (Bellman–Ford for contrast); on a grid map the mud cost decides whether to cross or go round; A* uses a heuristic to settle fewer cells. Teaching implementations on small graphs and grids, O(V²).

label.en: Expanding over a graph in order

reason.zh: 图算法页用队列和栈决定访问顺序；第 1 步用“暂定距离最小者先确认”决定访问顺序，得到加权最短路。
reason.en: The graph-algorithms page uses a queue or stack to decide visiting order; step 1 uses “smallest tentative distance first”, which yields weighted shortest paths.

label.en: Both accumulate a quantity over a graph

reason.zh: 最短路沿边累加权重得到距离，PageRank 沿边传递重要性；两者都是在有向/加权图上沿边做计算。
reason.en: Shortest paths add weights along edges to get distances while PageRank passes importance along edges; both compute along edges of a weighted or directed graph.

title.zh: 地图软件怎样找最短路线？
title.en: How does a map app find the shortest route?

note: graph-algorithms and pagerank are page slugs; remap if the coordinator has atlas nodes.
